changes.name: Canadian Malartic Complex
changes.previous: Prior dashboard had no 2026-11-18 capital-market-day Shaft #1 completion and Shaft #2 concept.
changes.current: Agnico Eagle investor-day update (2026-11-18): Odyssey Shaft #1 73% complete; first shaft production targeted June 2027. Second shaft concept 6.7m diameter x 1,740m depth, potential 8,000–10,000 tpd; studies H2 2027, permit amendment 2028, potential first production 2033. Complex pathway ~1.0Moz Au/year by 2033 inclusive of satellites, NOT current production.
changes.equipment_impact: Shaft sinking, underground development, ventilation, hoisting and life-cycle maintenance procurement; second shaft not FID.

changes.name: Upper Beaver Gold-Copper Project
changes.previous: No November 18 2026 target mining schedule and optional 8,000 tpd mill reflected in previous dashboard.
changes.current: Investor-day plans: underground first production H1 2030 subject to permits (expected early 2028). ~210koz Au/year plus ~3,600 t Cu/year at 5,000 tpd; potential expansion to 8,000 tpd under study, not approved. Ramp and exploration shaft progressing; bulk sampling from 160 level targeted H1 2027; technical update Q2 2027.
changes.equipment_impact: Potential underground mining fleets, shaft equipment, mill equipment and long-term maintenance contracts; investment depends on feasibility and permits.

changes.name: Hammond Reef Gold Project
changes.previous: No updated 2026 investor-day project timeline and detailed fleet-scale parameters in current dashboard.
changes.current: Agnico Eagle 2026-11-18 presentation: two-pit open-pit concept with mining ~100,000 tpd, milling ~33,500 tpd, annual gold 250–300koz over 13 years; Probable Mineral Reserves 123.5Mt @0.84 g/t Au (3.3Moz). Updated technical evaluation Q2 2027, possible permits/project approval 2029, production ramp-up targeted 2032, all conditional.
changes.equipment_impact: Large potential haul-truck/dozer/shovel fleet, ancillary haul-road upgrade ~38km, 19km 230kV line, and significant aftermarket; no FID yet.

changes.name: Wilson Gold Project
changes.previous: No current NI 43-101 MRE previously established in the consolidated dashboard.
changes.current: Epic Gold's initial independent MRE (effective 2026-11-09; disclosed 2026-11-19): 3.047Mt @2.85 g/t Au =279,000oz Inferred. Open-pit constrained: 2.405Mt @2.66 g/t/205,000oz; UG-constrained: 0.642Mt @3.57g/t/74,000oz. These are mineral resources, NOT reserves or an approved mine plan.
changes.equipment_impact: Exploration and technical services near term. Mining fleet opportunity unquantified until PEA/PFS/permits.
changes.method: Open pit + underground resource constraints (no mining decision)

changes.name: Fenton Gold Project
changes.previous: No current NI 43-101 MRE previously established in the consolidated dashboard.

changes.name: AZ Copper-Gold Project
changes.previous: Early exploration; new 2026 regional surface geochemistry results not yet recorded.
changes.current: Yukon Metals announced 2026 regional samples showing up to 10.41% Cu and up to 6.27g/t Au in selected surface rock samples at Viper, Saddle (new skarn) and Wrangell zones. Selected samples are not representative of deposit grade or an MRE. 100%-owned project in Yukon, Canada.
changes.equipment_impact: Potential future drilling/service opportunities; no reserves, mine-life estimate, approval, or heavy mining fleet demand.
